sources.title: Pareto Distribution Calculator — d.calculators
sources.snippet: The Pareto distribution is the classic "80/20 rule" distribution: it describes quantities where a small share of cases account for a large share of the total, like wealth, city sizes or file sizes. It needs two positive parameters — a scale x_m, the smallest value the quantity can take, and a shape alpha, which controls how heavy the tail of large values is. This calculator returns the .

sources.title: On Hilbert's sum type inequalities
sources.snippet: The main purpose of the present article is to give some new Hilbert's sum type inequalities, which in special cases yield the classical Hilbert's inequalities. Our results provide some new estimates to these types of inequalities.
